acceptanceCriteria: script/local-console-release-gate invokes corvint-companion-release with only flags it defines, and a test or live run of the gate reaches the bundle build
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from PR #233 follow-ups, confirmed on origin/main edc7901: script/local-console-release-gate:66-67 execs corvint-companion-release with -corvint-root and -taskman-root, but cmd/corvint-companion-release/main.go:28-34 defines -source-root and -tasks-root (and #233 retires -tasks-root). flag.ContinueOnError therefore refuses the invocation; the gate cannot run at base.

completion.reason: Fixed in adafe83f (console release gate passes the corvint-companion-release flags). Contained in the 1.0.0-rc.1 candidate 94ca556f52c0349c0a48e0c3a3274f8a0b5e6db3 on origin/main. Owner-approved closure 2026-09-27.

title: local-console-release-gate passes flags corvint-companion-release does not define
